title: Apply the change and verify your earlier work
goal: Apply one new attribute to your copy, save a note in an earlier customer and reconcile existing requests and report.

prerequisites.text: 1c-enterprise.a 3; A1–A2: separate infobase, catalogs, references and documents; synthetic data only.

sections.title: From a familiar situation to a checkable question
paragraphs: Seeing the field is only half a check. Open an existing request, save its new channel, and establish that neighbouring data did not change. Verify the new capability together with previous behaviour.

sections.title: Where to act
paragraphs: Continue your service in a separate verified copy from the preceding lesson. Preserve the original and completedDT. The example adds a customer note; the independent task uses another document field in a further copy. Before changing anything verify the target and field list. Nexus stores the lesson and your note, but does not operate the external1Capplication.

sections.title: A saved description must be applied
paragraphs: The previous lesson saved the editable configuration. Enterprise uses database configuration, so Ctrl+S alone does not prove the field is available. F7 updates the database structure to match development. Use only the prepared copy after closing its Enterprise session.

Expect a change to Справочник.Клиенты adding УчебнаяЗаметка. The observed Реорганизация информации dialog shows one changed catalog. That does not imply another catalog or loss of old items. Cancel and investigate unexpected deletions, unrelated objects or unexplained requirements.

sections.title: Reason before acting
paragraphs: Verification should detect both missing functionality and damaged prior data.
Identify the infobase, list and particular record separately. A command, visible text and saved state are different things.

tables.caption: One change, two sides of verification
Deleting a field is not a safe return

sections.title: Test the same earlier item
paragraphs: After successful updating, open this copy in Enterprise and choose Клиенты. Its automatic form/list exposes Учебная заметка. Open the earlier Учебный Север by your recorded code. Name and code should remain unchanged, and the new field initially empty.

Enter Учебная заметка сохранена в новой копии., choose Записать и закрыть and reopen the same code. A reread value is stronger evidence than clicking Write. Creating a new customer instead does not test preservation of the earlier identity.

sections.title: Predict the result
paragraphs: After updating the report still totals 120. Is that enough to establish that every field is preserved?

reveal.title: Check the reasoning
paragraphs: No. An equal total can conceal replaced records or offsetting errors. Check your four numbers and fields, then the new value after reopening, and the report total separately.

sections.title: Check neighboring capabilities too
paragraphs: Reopen old request numbers and compare customer, service, minutes, status and comments. Adding a customer note should not change them. Generate the unrestricted report: the sequential dataset remains four/120, first customer three/105 and second one/15. Reconcile your own expectation for additional work.

Counts and sums do not replace identities and field comparison. Different sets can produce equal totals. The actual illustration shows the total after changing metadata; your control table additionally checks concrete numbers. Stronger engineering acceptance compares references and every agreed field independently of the report.

sections.title: Context and transitions
paragraphs: Read the path and explain what changes at each step. The diagram does not operate the external application.

alternative: Same item: Write → close → reopen → Note retained.
Previous work: Numbers and report → Regression checked.

sections.title: Check the explanation’s boundary
paragraphs: Unexpected deletion in the update causes cancellation and investigation, not automatic acceptance.
Apply F7 to the correct copy, wait and open a fresh client.

sections.title: Rollback returns a state, not just a caption
paragraphs: If the field is absent, first verify the infobase, successful F7 and a freshly opened Enterprise window. A custom form in another configuration might require separate field presentation; this does not justify loading an arbitrary .cf over development. This package’s form is automatic and observed on the stated platform version.

For a serious discrepancy the original remains a separate return point. Restore a .dt into another new empty infobase and reconcile against its export date. Later records do not appear in that older backup automatically. Do not delete the attribute merely to roll back: entered notes can be lost. Preserve the failed attempt, explain the cause, then choose a repair.

sections.title: A new independent task
paragraphs: Apply the new УчебныйКанал definition only to your selected copy. Before entering a value verify an empty channel in the existing first request. Save “Учебная форма” (“Training form”), reopen and read it. Compare all previous fields of the four requests and report 4/120. The second request’s channel must remain empty; preserve the original infobase and the example’s customer note.
Record a prediction first. After your own attempt reveal the reference and compare the selected record as well as its number.

sections.title: Actual training-service window
paragraphs: The author created two new training copies by actualDTrestore. One applies customer note 80; the other adds request channel 40. Saving, restarting and comparing all eight old fields, identities and report 4/120 were performed. Two GUI captures show only saved values. Complete manual attribute creation, 80/81 and 40/41 boundaries, all learner steps, permissions and installer are NOT RUN.

sections.title: What the result establishes
paragraphs: The author created two new training copies by actualDTrestore. One applies customer note 80; the other adds request channel 40. Saving, restarting and comparing all eight old fields, identities and report 4/120 were performed. Two GUI captures show only saved values. Complete manual attribute creation, 80/81 and 40/41 boundaries, all learner steps, permissions and installer are NOT RUN.
Technical checks do not assess understanding. Distinguish your observations from unperformed steps. Training names, numbers and comments are fictional; no work data is required.

selfcheck.prompt: After updating the report still totals 120. Is that enough to establish that every field is preserved?
selfcheck.feedback: No. An equal total can conceal replaced records or offsetting errors. Check your four numbers and fields, then the new value after reopening, and the report total separately.

selfcheck.prompt: What applies the structure to the database?
After saving the first request’s channel the second should have…
options: An empty channel; old fields and report 4/120 unchanged
A new number replacing the old one
selfcheck.feedback: After updating the selected copy the existing request has a channel, initially empty. Saving and reopening the first reads “Учебная форма” (“Training form”). The second number still has an empty channel; all four documents retain previous references, dates, minutes, statuses and comments. The report gives four requests 120 minutes. The original opens separately without my edit. Stop and record any discrepancy; an unverified DT file is not a completed rollback.

selfcheck.prompt: How did you distinguish the field definition, applying it to the infobase and a saved value? Name your own copy, observation and unperformed check.
selfcheck.feedback: This free response is not graded automatically. Compare it with actual fields in your own infobase.

steps.title: Apply to the own copy
steps.action: Verify the target and update its database configuration. Read the expected changes before continuing.
steps.expected: Only the intended definition is applied.

steps.title: Save one channel
steps.action: Verify the own number, empty channel and previous fields; save “Учебная форма” (“Training form”).

steps.title: Read and compare
steps.action: Reopen both requests, compare all four numbers and previous fields; generate the report and verify 4/120.
steps.expected: The new value and previous behaviour persist.

steps.title: Verify the original
steps.action: Open the original and verify it did not receive the copy’s edit. Distinguish observations from unperformed steps in your note.
